Houston, if you found Ali Siddiq through *The Domino Effect*, this is your chance to hear those kinds of stories live.

Ali started doing stand-up in Houston in 1997. His sets move like real conversations—about family, growing up, and the hard lessons that stay with you. *My Two Sons* won the 2026 NAACP Image Award for Outstanding Variety Special. We’d make plans for this one.

Houston Improv · Wednesday, November 25, 2026

Houston, Ron Taylor won Netflix’s Funny AF with Kevin Hart this year.

His Tubi special, *Avalanche*, came out in 2025, but live is where his point of view lands best. He puts a silly flair on serious things and knows how to stay with a topic long enough to find the good part. If you like comedy that gets loose without losing the point, I’d bring a friend to this one.

Punch Line Houston · Friday, November 27, 2026

Houston, Michael Blackson taped *I Deported Myself* in Accra, and he’s headed your way.

He’s been working rooms since Philadelphia clubs in 1992, with immigrant stories, one-liners, and crowd riffs. You may know him from *Wild ’N Out* or *Next Friday*, but live is where that brash, high-energy style gets room to move. I’d bring the friend who laughs loud and doesn’t mind being part of the room.

Houston Improv · Friday, November 27, 2026
